text:
maria: Quick sync: we need a short 'canary + fallback' section in the v1->v2 migration doc. Keep it 6-8 lines, include: curl smoke test, TS/Py snippet for graceful fallback, a note about embedding-dim mismatch, and a support template. Who can own?

ethan: I can draft. Plan: add a tiny canary example that prefers v2 but falls back to v1 on network errors/status 502/503. Also add a short curl check and an automated smoke-test GH action.

ethan: Draft curl smoke test (single-line):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hello"}' || curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

ethan: Draft Py snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
try:
    resp = c.generate(model='redwood-v2', input='hi')
except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError):
    # availability fallback to v1; beware embedding dims
    resp = c.generate(model='redwood-v1', input='hi')
```

ethan: Draft TS snippet:
```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Client()
async function gen(p){
  try{ return await c.generate({model:'redwood-v2', input:p}) }
  catch(e){
    // only fallback on network/5xx
    if (e.status >= 500) return c.generate({model:'redwood-v1', input:p})
    throw e
  }
}
```

nina: Nice. Two copy nits: 1) explicitly call out 'embedding vectors may change dimension between models; re-encode or align index' 2) add a one-liner: 'If determinism is required, pin to redwood-v1 until validated'.

docs-ci: Lint: ok. Suggestion: don't use broad ConnectionError in examples; show pattern matching on error codes. Recommend adding telemetry comment: `// emit metric: fallback_used` so users can track regressions.

oliver: From support POV please include a template we can paste into tickets: "We observed fallback from redwood-v2 to redwood-v1 for request X at time Y. Please include request id and sample prompt. Recommendation: re-run against pinned v1 for deterministic results."

ethan: Will add support template + changelog note. I'll also add a short GH Action to run the curl smoke test on PRs to docs. PR link when ready.

maria: Make sure redirect map is updated for any changed examples/links and add an internal note under "breaking-changes". Keep the section small - one paragraph of guidance plus the two short snippets and curl.

ethan: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4628 — includes snippets, curl smoke test, GH action, and support template.

docs-ci: CI kicked: docs lint ok, smoke-test action queued. Note: one transient rate-limit on curl; action retries once.

support-bot: FYI: Monitoring channel #support will post alert if >5 fallback events/hour in production for any customer.

maria: Thanks — will review PR this afternoon. If green, merge and add a changelog bullet for the migration page.

ethan: PR updated per comments: added explicit error handling, telemetry note, and embedding warning. Pushed.

maria: LGTM. Merging once CI passes. Will ping support to watch for any new tickets referencing the PR.
